title: An iPhone X ad predicted Apple employees walking into the glass walls at its new $5 billion headquarters (AAPL)
text: An iPhone X ad predicted Apple employees walking into the glass walls at its new $5 billion headquarters (AAPL) Kif Leswing Apple campus More Apple employees have called 911 three times this year because people have walked into glass walls at the company's new $5 billion headquarters in Cupertino, California, Apple Park. The details were reported by San Francisco Chronicle's Wendy Lee and the story was broken by Bloomberg's Mark Bergen ; you can read the 911 transcripts here . But someone in Apple's marketing department may have been trying to subtly get the word out sooner — in a big, splashy ad for Apple's iPhone X that millions of people have seen.
